text:
anika: Heads up 1: SAST premerge started failing on a subset of PRs after yesterday's keystore ACL updates. Hits look like 'unable to decrypt artifact' and some evidence attachments missing from findings.
sam: Seen it. CI shows the analyzer couldn't fetch credentials for the sast-runner SA. I think the keystore key ACL now only grants roles to `infra-tooling@redwood` and we dropped `sast-runner@redwood`.
diego: Were there any concurrent RBAC renames? I merged infra/iam#421 yesterday which renamed `scanner-runner` -> `sast-runner` and updated bindings.
anika: The audit logs show a flurry of KMS DENIED events right when the PR merged. Example: ```
2025-06-01T08:04:12Z KMS ACCESS_DENIED key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/sast-key subject=serviceAccount:sast-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com proto=grpc
2025-06-01T08:04:13Z STORAGE READ_FAILED object=ci-artifacts/sast/2025-06-01-0804.tar.gz subject=serviceAccount:sast-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
ci-bot: SAST job #900 failed: decrypt error -> created alert (severity: high). Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/900
sam: Quick diagnostic I ran: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy sast-key --project=redwood` shows only `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` bound to infra-tooling. No entry for `sast-runner` yet PR #421 intended to add it but looks like the binding step failed in the apply stage.
diego: Ugh, terraform drift during apply. My local plan looked fine. Maybe the apply execution used an older state.
anika: Impact: premerge SAST gating on some repos is blocking merges. We can't have noisy blocking failures caused by infra rollouts. Proposal: set SAST gate to advisory for repos C and D while we fix binding.
sam: Agreed. I'll flip the gating rule to advisory and add a note to release checklist. Also will create an INF ticket for a fast rollback if bindings can't be fixed within 30m.
diego: I'll patch the infra PR and trigger another apply. Steps: re-run terraform apply with lockfile, confirm state, then run `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding sast-key --member=serviceAccount:sast-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`.
anika: Please also capture the SAST run IDs and attach artifacts for post-triage. We need to know which findings were real vs missing-evidence.
diego: Attached a quick run: `gs://ci-artifacts/sast/2025-06-01-0804.tar.gz` to the INF ticket. Also opened INF-1801: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1801 with logs and terraform plan.
anika: Good. We should also add an integration test to devex that validates KMS ACLs for all runner service accounts after infra apply (smoke test).
sam: I'll add a gating check in the SAST pipeline: before starting heavy scans, run `kms:can_decrypt` check for the runner SA and fail early with a clear message so it's easier to distinguish infra auth problems from real SAST findings.
diego: After I re-applied bindings, I ran a quick synthetic run and the decrypt errors stopped. Example success log: ```
2025-06-01T08:28:05Z sast-runner-3 INFO decrypt: OK key=sast-key subject=serviceAccount:sast-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
2025-06-01T08:28:06Z sast-runner-3 INFO upload: artifact attached=gs://ci-artifacts/sast/2025-06-01-0828.tar.gz
```
ci-bot: New SAST job #901 succeeded (smoke).
anika: Sweet. Revert the advisory gate back to blocking after we run a few targeted repos and confirm evidence attachments restored.
sam: Will do. Also adding an audit rule: when KMS ACCESS_DENIED spikes >50 in 10m, post to #eng-security and create INF auto-ticket so we're alerted earlier.
diego: I'll also add a note to the infra PR template reminding to coordinate keystore changes with security and devex.
anika: Thanks. Let's follow up with a short blameless postmortem capturing the root cause (apply used stale state), detection (audit logs + CI failures), mitigations (advisory gating, fix bindings), and long-term actions (devex smoke test + gating check + infra PR template). I'll draft it once INF-1801 is closed. :memo:
